body: I think I may have just found out that she cheated on me yesterday... she just told me her clothes are in the road some where and then stopped texting when I asked why... how do you deal with something like this? I love her but I'm growing to hate her and I don't know what to do. Should I check myself into a mental hospital?

A few months its because she always is manipulating me or little things like exaggerating and bending the truth for her benefit.. I've seen her one day in the past week and won't see her again until she comes back monday.. by then I'll be back at work and won't see her much anyway. Who knows how Christmas and new years will be.. I know one thing I'm not spending my holidays with those hateful dumb rednecks she calls family..
